fullDescription: A clean light-SaaS sticky navbar carried by one teal-to-lime gradient: a frosted white bar (white/85 + backdrop-blur over a hairline border) with a sparkle-tile 'Promptcraft' wordmark, five absolutely-centered nav links (Home, Library▾, Resources▾, Pricing, Blog) with a gradient underline that wipes in on hover, and a right cluster of a quiet 'Log in' link plus a gradient-filled 'Start free' CTA pill with a soft teal+lime glow shadow. Plus Jakarta Sans, Iconify Phosphor icons, gradient-text accent headline, and a hamburger reflow on mobile.

structured.summary: A clean, full-bleed light SaaS sticky navbar where the brand is carried by a single teal-to-lime gradient: a sparkle-tile wordmark 'Promptcraft' on the left, five centered nav links (Home, Library, Resources, Pricing, Blog) with two caret dropdowns and a gradient underline that wipes in on hover, and a right cluster of a quiet 'Log in' text link plus a gradient-filled 'Start free' CTA pill with a soft glowing colored shadow. The header is a frosted white bar (white/85 with backdrop-blur) over a thin hairline border, sitting above a full landing page (a mesh-tinted hero with a gradient-text headline, a floating browser-style preview card, a logo marquee, a feature triptych, and a big gradient CTA banner) so the sticky bar has real content to scroll over. Built on Plus Jakarta Sans with Iconify Phosphor icons; it reflows to a hamburger button on mobile.

style.description: A modern, friendly light-SaaS aesthetic where one teal-to-lime (#14b8a6 -> #a3e635) gradient is the entire brand signature. The page is white with near-black teal-tinted ink text (#0c1a18) and muted slate-teal secondary text (#475a57); the gradient is reserved for brand moments only: the sparkle logo tile, the primary CTAs, the headline accent words (clipped gradient text), the nav-link underline, and the closing banner. Surfaces are soft and airy: large rounded corners (rounded-xl to rounded-3xl), hairline ink borders at very low opacity (ink/[0.06]-ink/15), and a faint two-spot radial 'mesh' glow tinting the hero. The signature lift is a colored CTA glow shadow (a teal + lime double drop-shadow) rather than a flat gray shadow, and CTAs nudge up 1px on hover. Typography is Plus Jakarta Sans throughout, extrabold (800) for the wordmark and headlines, medium/semibold for nav + body. No gradients on text except the deliberate accent words; no harsh shadows; everything reads light, rounded, and premium.
style.prompt: Use a clean light-SaaS design system on the Tailwind CDN with these EXACT custom tokens: colors ink #0c1a18 (primary near-black teal-tinted text), ink-soft #475a57 (muted slate-teal secondary text), ink-onbrand #16332e (the dark text placed ON the gradient, e.g. CTA labels), teal #14b8a6, teal-deep #0f766e, lime #a3e635. The brand gradient is a single shared utility `.grad` = `linear-gradient(95deg, #14b8a6 0%, #2bbf94 38%, #6fd072 70%, #a3e635 100%)` used as a fill on the logo tile, all primary CTAs, and the closing banner. Define `.grad-text` = `linear-gradient(100deg, #14b8a6 0%, #a3e635 100%)` with `-webkit-background-clip:text; background-clip:text; -webkit-text-fill-color:transparent; color:transparent;` for clipped gradient accent words. The signature CTA glow is `.cta-shadow` = `box-shadow: 0 10px 24px -8px rgba(20,184,166,.55), 0 2px 6px -2px rgba(163,230,53,.5);` (a teal + lime double shadow, NOT a gray shadow). Font (Google Fonts): Plus Jakarta Sans weights 400/500/600/700/800, set as `font-jakarta` and the body default, with `-webkit-font-smoothing: antialiased`. Body is `bg-white text-ink antialiased`. Corners are soft and large (rounded-lg/xl/2xl/3xl); borders are hairline ink at very low opacity (border-ink/[0.06] up to border-ink/15). Add a faint hero `.mesh` = two radial-gradient spots (teal at top-left ~10% opacity, lime at top-right ~14% opacity). Icons are Iconify Phosphor (ph:sparkle-fill, ph:caret-down-bold, ph:arrow-right-bold, ph:play-circle, ph:lightning-fill, ph:check-bold, ph:magic-wand-fill, ph:squares-four-fill, ph:code-fill, ph:list-bold, ph:x-logo, ph:github-logo, ph:discord-logo). Keep the gradient reserved for brand moments only; everything else is white, ink, or ink-soft. CTAs translate up 1px on hover (`hover:-translate-y-[1px]`).

layout_and_structure.description: A `sticky top-0 z-50` frosted white `<header>` (`bg-white/85 backdrop-blur-xl` with a `supports-[backdrop-filter]:bg-white/70` fallback and a thin `border-b border-ink/[0.07]`) whose inner content centers in a `mx-auto max-w-[1200px] px-5 sm:px-8` column at a fixed `h-[68px]` row. The row is a `flex items-center justify-between` with three zones: a sparkle-tile + 'Promptcraft' wordmark pinned left (shrink-0), an `absolute left-1/2 -translate-x-1/2` centered nav of five links (lg-only), and a right action cluster (shrink-0) of a 'Log in' text link + a gradient 'Start free' CTA pill + a lg:hidden hamburger button. Beneath the header sits a full landing page (a mesh-tinted centered hero + floating preview card, a full-bleed logo marquee, a centered feature triptych, a gradient CTA banner, and a footer) so the sticky bar scrolls over real content.

prompts.partPt: Sticky frosted Menu do Topo shell
prompts.prompt: Build a `<header class="sticky top-0 z-50 w-full border-b border-ink/[0.07] bg-white/85 backdrop-blur-xl supports-[backdrop-filter]:bg-white/70">`. The header pins flush to the top of the viewport and the page scrolls beneath it. Inside, center all content in a `mx-auto flex h-[68px] max-w-[1200px] items-center justify-between px-5 sm:px-8` row.

An anchor `flex shrink-0 items-center gap-2.5`: a `.grad .cta-shadow` square tile `flex h-9 w-9 items-center justify-center rounded-[11px]` holding a `ph:sparkle-fill` Iconify icon (width 20) in `text-ink-onbrand`, next to a `text-[19px] font-extrabold tracking-tight text-ink` wordmark reading 'Promptcraft'.

A `nav` positioned `absolute left-1/2 -translate-x-1/2` and `hidden lg:flex items-center gap-1` with `aria-label="Primary"`: five `.nav-link rounded-lg px-2.5 py-2 text-[15px] font-medium` links. 'Home' is `text-ink`; 'Library' and 'Resources' are `text-ink-soft` and each end with a `ph:caret-down-bold` caret (width 12, `opacity-60`) to read as dropdowns; 'Pricing' and 'Blog' are `text-ink-soft`. All have `transition-colors hover:text-teal`. Each `.nav-link` has a `::after` gradient underline (teal->lime) inset 10px left/right, 2px tall, that scales from scaleX(0) to scaleX(1) on hover over .25s.

A `flex shrink-0 items-center gap-2 sm:gap-3` cluster: (1) a 'Log in' text link `hidden sm:inline-flex rounded-lg px-3.5 py-2 text-[15px] font-semibold text-ink transition-colors hover:text-teal`; (2) the primary CTA = an anchor `.grad .cta-shadow inline-flex items-center gap-1.5 rounded-xl px-4 py-2.5 text-[15px] font-bold text-ink-onbrand transition-transform duration-200 hover:-translate-y-[1px]` reading 'Start free' + a `ph:arrow-right-bold` icon (width 15); (3) a `lg:hidden` hamburger `button` `ml-1 inline-flex h-10 w-10 items-center justify-center rounded-lg text-ink hover:bg-ink/5` with a `ph:list-bold` icon (width 22) and `aria-label="Open menu"`.

Below the header, a `.mesh relative w-full overflow-hidden` section with a `mx-auto max-w-[1200px] px-5 py-20 sm:px-8 sm:py-28` inner. Center a `max-w-3xl text-center` block: a pill badge (`inline-flex items-center gap-2 rounded-full border border-teal/30 bg-teal/[0.07] px-3.5 py-1.5 text-[13px] font-semibold text-teal-deep` with a `ph:lightning-fill` icon) reading '12,400+ prompts. One canvas.'; an `text-[40px] sm:text-[60px] font-extrabold leading-[1.05] tracking-tight text-ink` H1 'Ship UI from a sentence,' with a second line 'not a blank file.' wrapped in `.grad-text`; a `max-w-xl text-[17px] sm:text-[19px] leading-relaxed text-ink-soft` subhead; a CTA row (a `.grad .cta-shadow` 'Start free' pill + a white `border border-ink/15` 'Watch the demo' button with a `ph:play-circle` icon); and a `text-[13px] text-ink-soft/80` 'No credit card. Free forever tier.' line.

Under the hero copy, a `mx-auto max-w-[1080px] px-5 sm:px-8` wrapper holding a browser-style card `.ring-soft relative overflow-hidden rounded-2xl border border-ink/10 bg-white` (where `.ring-soft` = `box-shadow: 0 1px 0 rgba(12,26,24,.04), 0 12px 40px -22px rgba(12,26,24,.25)`). Its top bar is a `flex items-center gap-3 border-b border-ink/[0.06] bg-ink/[0.015] px-5 py-3` row with a small `.grad` sparkle tile, a faux prompt chip ('a pricing page with three tiers, teal accent'), and a teal 'Generated' status chip with a `ph:check-bold`. Below it a `grid grid-cols-2 sm:grid-cols-4 gap-4 p-5 sm:p-6` of four `h-28 rounded-xl border border-ink/[0.07]` placeholder tiles, the first and last faintly tinted with teal/lime `bg-gradient-to-br` washes.

prompts.part: Logo marquee + feature triptych + CTA banner + footer
prompts.partPt: Logo marquee + Recursos e Diferenciais triptych + Chamada Final para Ação banner + Rodapé
prompts.prompt: A full-bleed `border-y border-ink/[0.06] bg-ink/[0.015] py-7` band with an uppercase tracked label and an infinite `.marquee-track` (`@keyframes marquee { from{translateX(0)} to{translateX(-50%)} }`, 26s linear infinite) of six faded `text-ink/35` logo lockups (Launchpad, Blockwise, Orbit Labs, Polyline, Flowstate, Hexel, each with a Phosphor icon), duplicated for a seamless loop and masked with a horizontal linear-gradient mask. Then a centered `max-w-[1200px]` feature section: an H2 'Everything between idea and shipped UI' + subhead, over a `grid sm:grid-cols-3 gap-5` of three white `rounded-2xl border border-ink/[0.08] p-7` cards, each led by a `.grad .cta-shadow` rounded icon tile (ph:magic-wand-fill / ph:squares-four-fill / ph:code-fill). Then a full-bleed CTA banner: a `.grad mx-auto max-w-[1080px] rounded-3xl px-8 py-14 sm:px-14 sm:py-16 text-center` block with an `text-ink-onbrand` H2 'Your next interface is one prompt away.', a subhead, and a white `text-teal-deep` 'Start free' pill. Finally a footer `border-t border-ink/[0.07] bg-white` with the wordmark, a copyright line, and X/GitHub/Discord Phosphor social icons.

Above lg the bar is wordmark / absolutely-centered five-link nav / right cluster (Log in + Start free). Below lg, hide the centered nav and show the `lg:hidden` hamburger button; below sm, also hide the 'Log in' text link so only the wordmark + 'Start free' CTA + hamburger remain. The hero scales from `text-[40px]` to `sm:text-[60px]`, section padding from `py-20` to `sm:py-28`, and the preview-card grid from `grid-cols-2` to `sm:grid-cols-4`, so the bar and page never overflow at narrow widths.

special_ui_components.prompt: The primary CTA is an anchor filled with the shared `.grad` brand gradient (`linear-gradient(95deg, #14b8a6 0%, #2bbf94 38%, #6fd072 70%, #a3e635 100%)`), `rounded-xl px-4 py-2.5 text-[15px] font-bold text-ink-onbrand` (dark #16332e text ON the gradient), carrying the signature `.cta-shadow` colored glow `box-shadow: 0 10px 24px -8px rgba(20,184,166,.55), 0 2px 6px -2px rgba(163,230,53,.5)` and `transition-transform duration-200 hover:-translate-y-[1px]`, ending in a `ph:arrow-right-bold` icon. Reuse the same gradient + glow on the hero CTA and the hero logo tile so the brand reads as one accent.

Render the accent line of the H1 with `.grad-text` (`background-image: linear-gradient(100deg, #14b8a6 0%, #a3e635 100%); -webkit-background-clip:text; background-clip:text; -webkit-text-fill-color:transparent; color:transparent;`) so 'not a blank file.' is filled with the teal->lime gradient while the first line stays solid `text-ink`.

Each desktop nav link is a `.nav-link` (`position: relative`) with a `::after` bar: `left:10px; right:10px; bottom:2px; height:2px; border-radius:2px; background-image: linear-gradient(90deg, #14b8a6, #a3e635); transform: scaleX(0); transform-origin:left; transition: transform .25s ease;` that animates to `scaleX(1)` on hover, plus a `hover:text-teal` color shift, so a gradient underline wipes in from the left.

The header is `sticky top-0 z-50` with a translucent frosted treatment: `bg-white/85 backdrop-blur-xl` and a `supports-[backdrop-filter]:bg-white/70` progressive fallback, plus a thin `border-b border-ink/[0.07]` hairline, so the page content blurs softly behind the bar as it scrolls under.

'Library' and 'Resources' read as menu triggers: each is a `flex items-center gap-1` nav link ending in a `ph:caret-down-bold` Iconify caret (width 12) at `opacity-60`, signalling a dropdown without a heavy chevron.

A floating product preview card `.ring-soft rounded-2xl border border-ink/10 bg-white` (a soft layered drop shadow, not gray) with a faux app top bar (a small `.grad` sparkle tile + a prompt chip 'a pricing page with three tiers, teal accent' + a teal 'Generated' chip with a check) over a 4-up grid of rounded placeholder tiles, two of them faintly washed with teal/lime `bg-gradient-to-br` gradients, to imply a generated-canvas result beneath the hero.

structured.special_notes: Exact color tokens (Tailwind config): ink #0c1a18, ink-soft #475a57, ink-onbrand #16332e, teal #14b8a6, teal-deep #0f766e, lime #a3e635. The single brand gradient is `.grad` = linear-gradient(95deg, #14b8a6 0%, #2bbf94 38%, #6fd072 70%, #a3e635 100%) (fill on the logo tile, all primary CTAs, and the closing banner); `.grad-text` = linear-gradient(100deg, #14b8a6 0%, #a3e635 100%) clipped to text for accent words. The signature colored CTA glow is `.cta-shadow` = `0 10px 24px -8px rgba(20,184,166,.55), 0 2px 6px -2px rgba(163,230,53,.5)`. The nav-link underline = a 2px `linear-gradient(90deg, #14b8a6, #a3e635)` bar inset 10px, scaleX(0)->scaleX(1) on hover over .25s. `.mesh` = two radial spots (teal ~10% top-left, lime ~14% top-right). `.ring-soft` = `0 1px 0 rgba(12,26,24,.04), 0 12px 40px -22px rgba(12,26,24,.25)`. Font: Plus Jakarta Sans (Google Fonts, weights 400/500/600/700/800) as font-jakarta + body default, antialiased. Icons: Iconify Phosphor (ph:sparkle-fill, ph:caret-down-bold, ph:arrow-right-bold, ph:play-circle, ph:lightning-fill, ph:check-bold, ph:magic-wand-fill, ph:squares-four-fill, ph:code-fill, ph:list-bold, ph:x-logo, ph:github-logo, ph:discord-logo). The header is `sticky top-0 z-50 w-full`, frosted (bg-white/85 backdrop-blur-xl, supports-fallback bg-white/70) with a `border-b border-ink/[0.07]` hairline, centered in `mx-auto max-w-[1200px] px-5 sm:px-8` at `h-[68px]`; the centered nav is `absolute left-1/2 -translate-x-1/2 lg:flex`. Built with the Tailwind CDN + Iconify; corners are large rounded, borders are hairline ink at very low opacity, the gradient is reserved for brand moments only. The page beneath the bar (mesh hero with a gradient-text H1 + floating preview card, a logo marquee, a feature triptych, a gradient CTA banner, and a footer) is demo context so the sticky bar has something to scroll over; the prompt-library value is the navbar pattern itself.
